verdict.rationale: Firebase's first-party docs say Cloud Firestore caches active data so apps can write, read, listen to, and query while offline. They also say that when the device comes back online, Firestore automatically synchronizes local changes, with offline support for both mobile and web. This directly matches the story's core. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on reconnect conflict resolution and persistence configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of offline write sync (community items cover only realtime sync).
